thread:
sam.sales: Quick sync — Acme POC. Need to finalize hosting mode + acceptance criteria by EOD Fri. Summary below, please react with ✅ or leave blockers.

eva.se: Recap from presales call:
- Primary use case: document summarization + redaction pipeline (batch + API)
- Target latency: interactive UI 95p < 300ms for 256-token responses
- Throughput: expected 50 concurrent users, burst to 200 for 2h/day
- Evaluation: 200 prompt sets (edge/corner cases) + quality rubric

maria.security: Heads up — they flagged 3 mandatory controls in questionnaire:
1) Data residency (EU-only) — means region constraint
2) KMS key ownership (customer-managed required for Private or Dedicated with KMS integration)
3) Audit logs retention 365d and ability to export

sam.sales: So decision tree: Hosted (fastest) vs Dedicated (committed GPUs, supports CMK) vs Private (air-gapped/enterprise, longer lead). Which mode meets EU residency + CMK + 300ms 95p?

eva.se: Quick thoughts:
- Hosted: can pin to eu region but CMK support is limited; also P95 target likely misses on larger models unless we pick smaller/quantized model.
- Dedicated: yes for CMK + isolation; better latency predictability; need to size for bursts (50->200).
- Private: solves everything but onboarding timeline is ~8-12 weeks and infra team needed.

tom.finance: Pricing Qs from procurement — need rough TCO for POC (4 weeks):
- Requested: baseline qps and tokens/day to price dedicated vs hosted demo.
- Sam, Lucy — can you confirm expected monthly token volume for the POC window?

lucy.acme: For the POC week we expect ~150k requests total, avg 150 tokens/request. Peak concurrency noted above. We can commit to a 4-week POC. Acceptance: redaction accuracy >= 98% on our eval set, and response latency under 300ms 95% of the time in eu-west.

ben.ae: For the legal / procurement side — they want a fallback plan if SLA breaks. Also ask if ded instance supports multi-model fallbacks.

eva.se: Yes, routing policies can fallback to smaller quantized variant. We should include an explicit fallback in runbook: model v1.fp16 -> v1.q4 -> v0.9.q4 (latency tier). We'll test quality degradation.

ian.infra: From infra — Dedicated sizing suggestion: to hit 300ms 95p for 256 tokens with model X (redwood-llm-x-large-q4), we need 4x A100-equivalent GPUs reserved for baseline and autoscale to 8x for bursts. Lead time: 48-72h to provision Dedicated pool in EU. Private is multi-week.

deploy-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/presales-poc-hosting-matrix

sam.sales: OK, proposed immediate plan (actions):
1) Eva: prepare eval harness + 200 prompt sets by Wed EOD (owner: eva.se)
2) Ian: quote Dedicated pool cost + provisioning ETA (owner: ian.infra)
3) Maria: confirm CMK integration steps and exportable logs path (owner: maria.security)
4) Tom: draft 4-week pricing estimate for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (owner: tom.finance)
5) Ben: prepare fallback language for SOW, and list procurement blockers (owner: ben.ae)
6) Lucy: share PII sample and redaction acceptance script (owner: lucy.acme)

maria.security: Quick note on CMK: Dedicated supports KMS via our key-wrap flow; Private supports onboarded HSMs. We need the customer's KMS ARN and an admin for key policy changes.

lucy.acme: I can get KMS ARN by tomorrow. Also we will upload a small sample dataset to the sandbox for eval.

tom.finance: For cost calc — assuming 150k * 150 tokens = 22.5M tokens over POC. We'll model Hosted (pay-as-you-go) vs Dedicated (1 month reserved + overage). I'll post numbers once Ian gives GPU sizing.

eva.se: Example eval snippet (for test harness):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-llm-x-large-q4",
  "prompt": "<DOC_TEXT>\nSummarize and redact PII",
  "max_tokens": 256
}
```
We'll run 20 concurrent workers for load test.

ben.ae: Procurement blocker list: export controls, SOC2 reqs, contract term length. If Dedicated is chosen, legal wants 60-day trial clause and termination rights.

sam.sales: Timeline check — if we commit to Dedicated, Ian + Tom should have sizing + cost by tomorrow so we can present to customer on Thurs. If Private, we need to flag 8-12 week lead and ask if they can accept longer timeline.

lucy.acme: Dedicated preferred from our side if you can guarantee CMK and logs; otherwise Private is fine but slower.

ian.infra: I'll run cost/sizing and post a sample capacity plan by EOD. Also will include autoscale policy that keeps baseline reserved and supports 4x burst for 2h window.

eva.se: One more: define pass/fail for quality — redaction recall >= 98% and precision >= 99% on labeled eval. Also edge-case set: 50 prompts with obfuscated PII formats.

sam.sales: Great. If no blockers, we'll present Dedicated proposal + SOW draft on Thurs. React with ✅ if you own an item. If blocked, reply with the blocker.

lucy.acme: ✅ will provide KMS ARN + dataset by tomorrow.

ian.infra: ✅ working sizing + plan.

maria.security: ✅ will confirm CMK steps and logs export path.

tom.finance: ✅ drafting estimates; need Ian numbers.

ben.ae: ✅ drafting SOW fallback language.

eva.se: ✅ prepping eval harness + prompts.

sam.sales: Thanks all — closing loop tomorrow. If anyone gets a legal red line or technical blocker, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
